words.explanation: v. to become or cause to become soft or liquid（使）解冻，融化
words.example: What's the best way to unfreeze water pipes?

words.explanation: v. to (make sth.) become less bright （使）变暗淡
words.example: The lights dimmed and the play began.

words.explanation: a. covered with ice 冰封的；结冰的
words.example: He closed the door behind him and went down the icy path.

words.explanation: n. [C] an area of land that is beautiful to look at or has a particular type of appearance 风景；景色；地形；地貌
words.example: The island's landscape is different from Hawaii's.

words.explanation: a. always telling other people what to do in a way that is annoying 爱发号施令的；专横的
words.example: When we're out she gets really bossy and starts ordering me to do everything.

words.explanation: a. behaving in an angry way because you are feeling nervous and worried 紧张不安的；愤怒的
words.example: She gets uptight even about the slightest difficulty.

words.explanation: vt. ( usu. passive ) ( be ~ed with ) to think about sth. or sb. all the time and you cannot think of anything or anyone else 使着迷；使心神不宁
words.example: Why are you so obsessed with the English exam?

words.explanation: a. happening soon 即将来临的
words.example: They'll face a tough competition in the upcoming election.

words.explanation: n. [C] a ceremony at which two people become married, esp. one with a religious service（尤指有宗教仪式的）婚礼
words.example: I got that ring from my mother as a wedding present.

words.explanation: n. [C] the ceremony at which sb. is officially made king or queen 加冕典礼
a. feeling angry and unhappy because sb. has a quality, thing, or ability that you wish you had 妒忌的
words.example: He is very jealous of his brother's success.

words.explanation: a. sb. who is evil deliberately does very cruel things to harm other people 邪恶的；危害他人的
words.example: In the movie, the hero saved the city from an evil scientist.

words.explanation: n. [U] sth. you do in order to punish sb. who has harmed or offended you 报复
words.example: The soldiers began to take revenge on the attack.

words.explanation: v. to make a secret plan to harm a person or organization, esp. a political leader or government 密谋；策划；图谋
words.example: The king thought his people were plotting against him.

words.explanation: n. [C] ( the ~ ) the position of being king or queen 国王/女王的地位
a. violent and dangerous, and likely to hurt sb. 凶险的；会造成伤害的
words.example: He seems to be a wolf in sheep's clothing, looking kind but actually vicious.

words.explanation: n. [C] an imaginary animal or person, or one that is very strange and sometimes frightening 想象中的动物/人；怪物
vt. to be likely to harm or destroy sth. 威胁到；危害到
words.example: Water pollution is threatening the environment of this region.

words.explanation: n. [U] the act of working with sb. else to achieve sth. that you both want 合作；协作
words.example: The product was made in cooperation with a British company.

words.explanation: vt. to win a victory over sb. in a war, competition, game, etc. 战胜；打败
words.example: She was defeated in the last election.

words.explanation: vt. to make a record, CD, movie, etc. available for people to buy or see 发行；上映
words.example: The newly released film turns out to be very popular with young people.

words.explanation: n. [C] the most important or central part of sth.（事物的）最重要部分；核心
words.example: These 3,500 words form the core of the language.

words.explanation: ad. always, or very often 持续不断地；经常地
words.example: Languages are constantly changing.

words.explanation: n. [C, usu. pl.] the words of a song, esp. a modern popular song 歌词
vt. to communicate a message or information, with or without using words 传达；传播
words.example: A good photograph can convey far more than words.

words.explanation: n. [C] the part of a song that is repeated after each verse 副歌；叠句
vt. to completely change the appearance, form, or character of sth. or sb. 使改观；使变形；使转化
words.example: You can use a computer to transform a photograph into a greeting card.

words.explanation: a. friendly and attractive 友善可爱的；讨人喜欢的
words.example: My father was a lovable man, with a big smile anytime you see him.

words.explanation: n. [sing., U] the quality of expressing ideas or thoughts in a clear way 清晰；清楚；明确
words.example: The war brought these countries together with a clarity of purpose.

words.explanation: vt. to leave sb., esp. sb. you are responsible for 遗弃；抛弃
words.example: She claimed that her parents had abandoned her.

words.explanation: a. very pleasing or attractive; nice 可爱的；有魅力的；迷人的
words.example: My parents thought Bill was charming and agreed to marry me to him.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] strong unreasonable feelings of love for sb. or interest in sth. 迷恋；痴迷
n. [C, U] the act of giving up sth. important or valuable so that you or other people can do or have sth. else 牺牲
words.example: Parents often make many sacrifces for their children.

words.explanation: vt. ( fml. ) to eagerly accept new ideas, opinions, religions, etc. 欣然接受；采纳
words.example: The poor regions have embraced reforms.

words.explanation: to not give sb. a better job, choosing instead sb. who is younger or has less experience 对（某人）不予考虑
words.example: She was repeatedly passed over for promotion.

words.explanation: if sth. is out of control, people are not able to limit it or make it do what they want it to do 失去控制
words.example: Although Tim is just six, his behavior problems are getting out of his parents' control.

words.explanation: to work together with sb. else in order to achieve sth.（与某人）联合，合力
words.example: You must join forces in your scientific research.

words.explanation: a way of getting away from a difficult or unpleasant situation 出路；摆脱困难的办法
words.example: Alcohol is not a good way out of your problems.

words.explanation: to decide not to react to sth. bad or annoying that sb. has done or said 对某事不计较
words.example: It's time to let the past go.

words.explanation: to test sth. such as a method or a piece of equipment to see if it is effective or works well 试用；试验；检验
words.example: I wanted to try out my new bike at the weekend.

words.explanation: to be able to understand sth. or solve a problem 理解；明白；想出
words.example: Don't worry, they'll fgure out the problem by themselves.

words.explanation: if things fall into place, events happen in a way that is satisfactory for you 按令人满意的方式发生
words.example: When you are playing well, everything falls into place.

words.explanation: if people or groups grow apart, their relationship slowly ends（关系）逐渐疏远
words.example: I feel very sorry that we've been growing apart after that quarrel.

words.explanation: to try to avoid a problem or situation because it is difficult or embarrassing 逃避（问题或困境）
words.example: Sandy is not one who runs away from problems.
